parameters.query:
SELECT run_id, bu, period, facts, analysis_keys, numeric_html
FROM reports.report_runs
WHERE bu = $1 AND period = $2
ORDER BY generated_at DESC
LIMIT 1

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ report_html: $('Load Latest Run').first().json.numeric_html, analysis: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries($json.analysis).filter(([key]) => $('Load Latest Run').first().json.analysis_keys.includes(key))) }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO reports.report_analyses (run_id, requested_by, model, prompt_version, analysis, final_html)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6)
RETURNING analysis_id, run_id, created_at
